# Custom Navigation

Extend Chats, Contacts, Profile to Chats, Contacts, Work, Profile while keeping intents aligned.

## Vue Preview

<ComponentPreview name="AdaptiveNavigation" />

## Four Platforms

### Vue

~~~vue
const navigation = resolveNavigationItems(FLARE_DEFAULT_IM_NAVIGATION, [
  { id: "chats", label: "Chats", icon: "chats", order: 0 },
  { id: "contacts", label: "Contacts", icon: "people", order: 1 },
  { id: "work", label: "Work", icon: "folder", order: 2, intent: { type: "custom", id: "work" } },
  { id: "profile", label: "Profile", icon: "person", order: 3 },
]);
~~~

### Flutter

~~~dart
final defaults = flareDefaultIMNavigation(FlareStrings.of(context));
final navigation = resolveFlareNavigationItems(defaults, items: [
  defaults[0], defaults[1],
  const FlareNavigationItem(id: 'work', label: 'Work', icon: 'folder', order: 2, intent: FlareCustomNavigationIntent('work')),
  FlareNavigationItem(id: 'profile', label: defaults[2].label, icon: 'person', order: 3),
]);
~~~

### Android Compose

~~~kotlin
val defaults = flareDefaultIMNavigation(flareStrings())
val navigation = resolveNavigationItems(defaults, listOf(
    defaults[0], defaults[1],
    FlareApplicationNavigationItem("work", "Work", "folder", order = 2, intent = FlareNavigationIntent.Custom("work")),
    defaults[2].copy(order = 3),
))
~~~

### SwiftUI

~~~swift
@Environment(\.flareStrings) private var strings

let defaults = flareDefaultIMNavigation(strings)
let navigation = resolveNavigationItems(defaults: defaults, items: [
    defaults[0], defaults[1],
    FlareApplicationNavigationItem(id: "work", label: "Work", icon: "folder", order: 2, intent: .custom(id: "work", payload: [:])),
    FlareApplicationNavigationItem(id: "profile", label: defaults[2].label, icon: "person", order: 3),
])
~~~

## Icons

`icon` takes one of the kit's 99 semantic names (see ICON-LIBRARY), the same set on all four platforms — never a platform glyph. An unknown name draws the fallback glyph and warns once in a debug build.

## Defaults

The defaults are functions rather than constants on all four platforms, and their labels come from the strings table: `flareDefaultIMNavigation(strings)`. Take an item from the returned list to keep it, rather than re-typing its label.

## Responsive

The same list becomes a sidebar on PC, a rail on tablet, and bottom navigation on mobile/H5.
